authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Govt. of India)

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders — Specification
standards.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
standards.scope: Specifies materials, construction, workmanship, finish, and performance requirements for helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

criticalClauses.title: Impact Absorption Test
criticalClauses.requirement: Peak acceleration shall not exceed 300g (approx 2940 m/s²), and the duration of acceleration greater than 150g shall not exceed 5.0 milliseconds, dropped from 3.0m on flat and hemispherical steel anvils.

criticalClauses.title: Retention System Dynamic Test
criticalClauses.requirement: Chin strap shall not break; dynamic displacement under 10 kg drop weight from 0.75m shall not exceed 35 mm, and residual displacement shall not exceed 15 mm.

criticalClauses.title: Rigidity Test
criticalClauses.requirement: Initial load 30N, maximum load 630N applied along longitudinal and transverse axes. Deformation difference shall not exceed 40 mm.

standards.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts — Fineness and Marking
standards.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
standards.scope: Prescribes requirements for fineness and marking of gold jewellery and artefacts sold to Indian consumers.

criticalClauses.title: Mandatory Three Hallmark Symbols
criticalClauses.requirement: Every hallmarked article must bear: (1) BIS triangular mark, (2) Purity in carat and fineness (e.g., 22K916), (3) 6-digit alphanumeric laser HUID identifier.

criticalClauses.title: Statutory 3X Under-Caratage Compensation
criticalClauses.requirement: If purity is assayed below billed fineness, consumer is legally entitled to compensation equal to 3 times the purity difference calculated at current market rate, plus testing fee refund.

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
standards.ministry: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) & BIS
standards.scope: Prescribes microbiological, physical, and chemical requirements for packaged drinking water filled in sealed hermetic containers.

criticalClauses.title: Microbiological Cleanliness
criticalClauses.requirement: Total Coliforms, E. coli, Faecal Streptococci, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa must be completely ABSENT in 250 ml of sample.

criticalClauses.title: TDS and Physical Range
criticalClauses.requirement: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) range: 75 mg/L to 500 mg/L; Turbidity max 2 NTU; pH 6.5 to 8.5.

criticalClauses.title: Factory Testing Protocol
criticalClauses.requirement: Daily in-house microbiological incubation tests and daily testing of TDS, pH, and ozone/chlorine residual.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
standards.scope: Covers requirements of thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel bars for reinforced concrete structures.

criticalClauses.title: Chemical Composition Limits
criticalClauses.requirement: Carbon max 0.25% for Fe 500D; Sulphur max 0.040%; Phosphorus max 0.040%; S+P max 0.075%.

criticalClauses.title: Mechanical Properties
criticalClauses.requirement: Fe 500D: Yield strength min 500 MPa, Tensile strength min 565 MPa (TS/YS ratio ≥ 1.10), Total elongation min 16.0%.

criticalClauses.title: Mandrel Bend and Rebend Test
criticalClauses.requirement: Bars bent through 135° around mandrel, aged in boiling water at 100°C for 30 minutes, bent back through 157.5° without surface rupture or fracture.

standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
standards.scope: Applies to building wires, flexible cords, and general electric cables with copper or aluminum conductors.

criticalClauses.title: High Voltage Spark Testing
criticalClauses.requirement: All insulated cable cores must withstand online high-voltage AC spark testing at 6 kV AC (or 9 kV DC) during extrusion without breakdown.

criticalClauses.title: FRLS Insulation Fire Resistance
criticalClauses.requirement: Flame Retardant Low Smoke (FRLS) cables must satisfy Critical Oxygen Index min 29% and Halogen Acid Gas emission ≤ 20% by weight.
